recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If a future generated core package or rendered build shows the old wording, address the build input or THO dependency/publication path rather than adding a core CodeSystem source file.
issue_request: FHIR-32480 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care issue requesting that the ConditionVerificationStatus confirmed definition be changed from the tautological wording to "There is sufficient evidence to assert the presence of the subject's condition."
initial_application: No Jira-tagged core source commit was found for FHIR-32480. The core duplicate CodeSystem file source/condition/codesystem-condition-ver-status.xml had already been removed by a3768d9df82b8b5b5b7bedfbe08618ea365d9b2f as a THO duplicate before the issue was resolved, and the implementation path recorded in Jira was the UTG/THO proposal UP-387.
additional_context: FHIR-32479 is the companion issue for unconfirmed. UP-387 is Proposal Implemented and records the Patient Care-approved definitions for both unconfirmed and confirmed. The current core source binds Condition.verificationStatus to the Condition Verification Status ValueSet, and that ValueSet composes codes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/condition-ver-status. The CodeSystem OID is commented in source/oids.ini, consistent with the CodeSystem being external to core.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The authoritative THO CodeSystem at terminology.hl7.org and the local hl7.terminology.r5#5.3.0 package already define confirmed as "There is sufficient evidence to assert the presence of the subject's condition." Editing core would reintroduce an external THO duplicate or touch stale/generated package surfaces.

related_jiras.note: Companion Applied issue for the unconfirmed ConditionVerificationStatus definition; it was implemented through the same UP-387 THO proposal but was not separately decided in this seed result.
Implemented UTG/THO terminology proposal that applied the FHIR-32480 confirmed definition and the FHIR-32479 unconfirmed definition.
